note: Exposes /metrics (route monitoring_prometheus.metrics) for Prometheus scraping of Monitoring sensors. Access gated by permission access monitoring prometheus metrics + IP allowlist (MetricsController::ipAccess). Config monitoring_prometheus.settings: allowed_ips (sequence), custom_labels (sequence). Baseline: submodule not enabled. Medium cases enable it, seed known config, and read it back; hard cases require configuring allowed_ips / custom_labels, verified against live config (reset enables + clears the key). All grounded in real route/permission/config keys.

evals.prompt: The monitoring_prometheus submodule exposes Monitoring sensors for scraping. At what URL path, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: It serves the /metrics path (route monitoring_prometheus.metrics), gated by the 'access monitoring prometheus metrics' permission plus an optional IP allowlist.

evals.prompt: How do I restrict which servers may scrape the monitoring_prometheus /metrics endpoint, and in which config object is that stored?
evals.expected_output: Set the allowed_ips sequence in monitoring_prometheus.settings; if non-empty only those client IPs may scrape (empty = any IP, permission still applies). Checked by MetricsController::ipAccess().

evals.prompt: How can I add extra labels (for example an environment name) to the metrics exported by monitoring_prometheus?
evals.expected_output: Set the custom_labels sequence in monitoring_prometheus.settings; those labels are attached to every exported metric.

evals.prompt: On this site monitoring_prometheus is configured to restrict who can scrape /metrics. Inspect the live monitoring_prometheus.settings and report the IP address in its allowed_ips list.
monitoring_prometheus on this site is configured to add a custom label to exported metrics. Inspect the live monitoring_prometheus.settings and report the value of the 'env' custom label.
Configure monitoring_prometheus so that only the Prometheus server at IP 10.9.8.7 is allowed to scrape the /metrics endpoint. Apply the change to the live site.
I scrape several sites into one Prometheus. Please tag this site's exported metrics with an environment label whose value is 'production', so I can tell them apart.
evals.expected_output: monitoring_prometheus.settings:custom_labels contains the value 'production' (e.g. drush cset monitoring_prometheus.settings custom_labels.env production).
